blockers.resolution: Run a representative real-image deterministic Try-On quality/resource review covering garment/logo/pattern preservation, failure modes, latency and memory; record immutable reviewed evidence before RC.
Reach HSME R&D_VALIDATED with at least one trusted physical-mobile backend/evidence set, integrated dense-vs-HSME comparison, and final ADVANCE/REDESIGN/REJECT architecture decision.

selectionLaw: BERS_V1_RC may be assigned only when blockers is empty, rcSelectable is true, rcCoordinate is one exact accepted main SHA with mandatory release evidence green, fashionQualityEvidence is accepted, and hsmeValidation.currentClassification is R&D_VALIDATED. Fashion/HSME evidence gates grant no production authority by themselves.

blockers.detail: The dense mobile/DiT baseline must be finalized from trusted real evidence and reach the reviewed pinned-baseline state; synthetic contract evidence is insufficient.
A functioning compact Adapter-MoE/sparse prototype and same-fixture dense/Top-1/Top-2 comparison are still required.
Adaptive residency/cache/prefetch/bytes-moved mechanisms require real runtime/device evidence and a disposition.
Representative selective sparse-block candidates need real target-hardware measurement and ADVANCE/REDESIGN/REJECT dispositions.
Stage/timestep routing requires real target-device execution and an explicit disposition.
Spatial/token sparsity requires real target-device execution with strict preservation evidence and an explicit disposition.
At least one real physical mobile backend must provide independently trusted same-session latency, memory, storage/bytes-moved, battery/energy, thermal/throttling and quality evidence.
The final integrated dense-vs-HSME hardware comparison and architecture ADVANCE/REDESIGN/REJECT decision are still required.
